title: Closing-auction pressure reverses overnight (Bogousslavsky & Muravyev, 'Who trades at the close?'): QQQ imbalance -> NQ against the imbalance overnight
registered: 2026-10-20, before any Gen244 number (Gen242 only looked at 15:51-16:00)
rule: same daily imbalance signal as Gen242 (first closing message at/after 15:50, |dollar imbalance| > 20-day median); position = OPPOSITE of the imbalance side in NQ; 0.5 units; 2 x cost_frac

variants.ON18: from the 18:00 ET reopen to 09:30 next day (MFFU / Tradeify compatible)
variants.ON16: from the 16:00 close (settlement) to 09:30 next day (swing firms)
